title: Halation Loop
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume song, not an intro. The first and last beats both have complete drums, bass, chords and a melodic hook at stable level. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo MELODIC TRANCE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 144 BPM in 4/4. A firm four-on-the-floor kick lands on every quarter beat, crisp clap on two and four, eighth hats, a separate short pitched arpeggio attack on each quarter beat, rounded bass and wide warm chords. Signature hook: six staccato ascending notes curve back to a two-note low reply, alternating between a bright pluck and a soft bell-like synthesizer; one long chord glow stays behind the clear beats. At 64 seconds maintain the same groove and loudness, change chord roots, reverse the six-note contour and let the two-note reply rise rather than fall. Keep the full 128 seconds active, evolving and distinctly melodic rather than repeating an identical half. No quiet intro, slow build, breakdown, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: two incomplete offset frequency rings, one ivory and one cyan, meet at a single coral diamond; six small beat ticks follow an arc but no star, sun, planet or astronomical symbol. Compact legible motif for mobile cards, no figures or text.
og_prompt: Purpose-composed horizontal duohertz card with the two incomplete frequency rings on the right, lowercase duohertz and Halation Loop on the left. Sparse halftone and dark editorial panel, no copied game art.
